newsitem.title: USA: Amtran's American Trans Air Sept load off.
newsitem.headline: Amtran's American Trans Air Sept load off.

text.p: American Trans Air Inc, a unit of Amtran Inc, said its September passenger load factor declined four points to 64.0 percent from 68.0 percent a year ago.
Revenue passenger miles gained 0.6 percent to 647.7 million from 644 million, and available seat miles gained 6.8 percent to 1.01 billion from 947 million.

Year to date, it said the load factor fell 2.5 points to 69.9 percent from 72.4 percent. The carrier said consolidated revenue passenger miles rose 6.9 percent to 7.48 billion from 7.00 billion, and available seat miles increased 10.8 percent to 10.71 billion from 9.66 billion.
